title: Shared rules for all housing help
parameters: Income, income lines, immigrant eligibility, verification, conditions and residency, kept in one place; no work or treatment condition; no residency rules
eligibility: All households under HOU-4, HOU-4A, HOU-4D, HOU-1D

vehicle.note: definitions; disapplies 42 U.S.C. 1437j(c) to new awards
restated as conditions on new money

title: One rental help system (guarantee, vouchers, emergency help harmonized)
parameters: Common application, shared access points, one household record, income found once reused for 12 months, defined hand-offs; consent-based record sharing until the regular bill passes
eligibility: Applicants to HOU-1D, HOU-4A, HOU-4D, HOU-4.08

title: Order of reach
parameters: Stage 1 people without a home (families first) 2030-33; stage 2 ELI families with children with severe problems; stage 3 disabled ELI renters from 2038; within stage: severity, youngest children, date
eligibility: As stated; local preferences allowed, no residency rules

title: Matching the tool to the market
parameters: Tight market: vacancy <=4% two years or <50% lease-up in 180 days (judgment); 2030-31 vouchers everywhere; from 2032 up to 25% attached in tight markets, max 50% after evaluation; move with a voucher after 12 months, funded from the household's own award; no attached awards in tracts over 30% poverty; randomized evaluation by 2036
eligibility: New awards under HOU-4A and HOU-4D

vehicle.note: on HOU-4A, HOU-4D and HOU-3C money

current_law: Project-based voucher authority 42 U.S.C. 1437f(o)(13); change: its share cap is lifted for these awards

title: Payment limits by neighborhood
parameters: Small Area Fair Market Rents in metro areas; tight markets 2030, all metros by 2032; two-year hold harmless
eligibility: All tenant-based vouchers in metro areas

vehicle.note: codify in 1437f(o); HUD may act by rule first

title: National source-of-income protection
parameters: Bars refusal or different terms because rent is paid with housing assistance; Fair Housing Act remedies; effective 2030
eligibility: Rental housing covered by the Fair Housing Act
current_law: State and local laws that protect more stay

title: Search help with every new award
parameters: Per-award fee to housing agencies for counseling, landlord outreach, deposits and fees; starts from ROAD's pre-inspected unit list
eligibility: New tenant-based awards and moves from attached homes

title: Stage 3: disabled extremely low-income renters from 2038

parameters: Enrollment from 2038; vouchers or awards attached to reserved accessible homes; HCBS offered, never a condition; pace with care flagship and section 6

vehicle.note: authorized now, effective 2038; or the care flagship's bill

title: Housing First as the federal rule
parameters: Revoke the 2025 order's conditions (January 2029); statutory Housing First standard for HUD and HHS homelessness help; navigator offered, declining never ends housing; ESG no-sweeps extension is a yes-or-no for Espen
eligibility: People served by federal homelessness help and new awards
agency: HUD, HHS, Interagency Council on Homelessness
current_law: Reverses EO of July 2025; reissues the July 2027 national plan

title: Voluntary recovery-housing option
parameters: Grants through Continuums of Care to operators meeting a quality standard, 2030-34, randomized evaluation for people with active addiction, renewed on results
eligibility: People who choose a sober setting; never a condition

title: Supportive housing: draft engagement standard (a duty on providers) and treatment access
status: principle decided (memo 5 B); parameters drafted from the research note (recommendations 1-3, 6, 8, 9), for Espen
parameters: Named navigator offered; contact expected at least monthly; provider follows a set re-engagement protocol; non-engagement never ends lease, subsidy or place; amend 24 CFR 578.75(h) and HUD-VASH (automatic move to a regular voucher); providers offer or connect to medicines for opioid use disorder, naloxone, contingency management, ACT; priority for highest-use chronically homeless people; report contact, retention, overdose deaths, medicine starts, exits; restore the CoC permanent housing priority
eligibility: Tenants of federally funded supportive housing
current_law: Amends 24 CFR 578.75(h) and the HUD-VASH notice; research note dossiers/home/research-supportive-housing.md

title: Services and workforce for supportive housing
status: draft from the research note (recommendations 4-6), for Espen
parameters: Ask the care flagship (HLT-4) to cover tenancy supports, navigation and ACT; HUD services backstop for tenants without Medicaid, paid by contract with staffing and contact standards; wage floors, caseload limits, peer training
eligibility: Supportive-housing tenants

title: One million new awards, 2030-33
parameters: 250,000 new awards a year 2030-33 with continuing help; form per HOU-4.04; mandatory, outside the yearly renewal vote
eligibility: Stage 1, then the start of stage 2

title: Housing agency administration for the new awards
parameters: $12.2B FY2030-39 planning allowance, covering intake through the common application; fees paid in full, never prorated, plus a one-time issuance fee per new award
eligibility: Housing agencies

title: Stage 2: a guarantee for the poorest families with children
parameters: Enrollment opens 2034, up to 300,000 a year; a right from 2037; $135B is an estimate, not a cap; exit rule judgment
eligibility: Unassisted ELI renter households with a child under 18 and severe problems

title: Standing emergency-rent fund: eligibility, uses, caps
parameters: Back rent and utilities plus up to two months ahead, deposit or moving; cap four months of FMR (HUD indexes); one episode in 12 months, two in 3 years; legal help paid separately; permanent
eligibility: Renters at or below 50% AMI or enrolled in SNAP, Medicaid or SSI, facing a crisis now
current_law: New; no standing federal program exists

title: How the fund pays
parameters: Tested risk screen, court cases first; self-attestation in statute with pre-payment identity, tenancy and ownership checks and post-payment sample audits; landlord applications with consent; landlord paid first, tenant after 10 days; no eviction for paid months; pay within 30 days
eligibility: As HOU-1D.01

title: Accountability: grantees, errors, data
parameters: One administrator per place (states, localities of 200,000+, and tribes or tribally designated housing entities); links to courts, legal aid, 211; need-and-performance formula; first-year error-rate sample published yearly; monthly payment-level data standard shared with HOU-4.02
eligibility: Grantees

title: One-time start, 2030-31
